mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_policy ( policy_id, tenant_id, policy_name, alert_type, default_level, dedupe_strategy, dedupe_window_seconds, notify_channel, initial_notify_status, owner_scope, enabled, rule_config_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{policyId}, #{tenantId}, #{policyName}, #{alertType}, #{defaultLevel}, #{dedupeStrategy}, #{dedupeWindowSeconds}, #{notifyChannel}, #{initialNotifyStatus}, #{ownerScope}, #{enabled}, #{ruleConfigJson}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_policy SET policy_name = #{policyName}, default_level = #{defaultLevel}, dedupe_strategy = #{dedupeStrategy}, dedupe_window_seconds = #{dedupeWindowSeconds}, notify_channel = #{notifyChannel}, initial_notify_status = #{initialNotifyStatus}, owner_scope = #{ownerScope}, enabled = #{enabled}, rule_config_json = #{ruleConfigJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}
mapper.select: SELECT policy_id, tenant_id, policy_name, alert_type, default_level, dedupe_strategy, dedupe_window_seconds, notify_channel, initial_notify_status, owner_scope, enabled, rule_config_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_policy WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT policy_id, tenant_id, policy_name, alert_type, default_level, dedupe_strategy, dedupe_window_seconds, notify_channel, initial_notify_status, owner_scope, enabled, rule_config_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY alert_type ASC
